ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher and remind the driver that a no-show cancellation requires the "I'm Here" tap plus >3 minutes of waiting within the pickup radius.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement that he waited at least 5 minutes is contradicted by system records: arrival at 21:28:05 [F5] to cancellation at 21:30:55 [F4] is only 2 min 50 s, and cumulative time within 200 m is 2 min 50 s [F2]; GPS/timeline override statements.

Claimed 'I'm Here' tap at 21:29:10 is not corroborated by the timeline field (driver_pressed_here_at null [F7]); even if accepted, only 1 min 45 s of waiting followed, below the NS-1(iii) 3-minute threshold.
